findings.section_selection: Reader derives source sections from frozen summary and chooses them itself; no key or question-specific section recommendations.
findings.reader_file_boundary: Prompt permits only frozen summary/questions and own artifacts. Inline algorithm needs no parent helper import. Companion checker CLI reads both raw answers and is parent-side only. Actual runtime allowed-input audit still required.
findings.grading_boundary: All substantive same-entry fields count. Structural format failures and support/confidence labels do not impose factual score caps. Material missing/wrong/unresolved rules remain failures.
